title: IKEA boxes with 27estore gloss lacquer fronts
summary: The only route found with true high gloss, any RAL colour for a bright lower and a light upper, and a published price, about 11,000 USD for this kitchen. Gentian blue under oyster white is the recorded pair; any RAL pair costs the same. The integrated handle is seen in one image only (A4).
